Definition: properly, double, i.e. second; also adverbially, again
BiblicalUsage: The second day closes the first work of division in Genesis, and Pharaoh's king speaks to the Hebrew midwives, of whom the name of the one is Shiphrah and the name of the other Puah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that second is a plain counting word, and the Bible uses it to order days, sons, and witnesses.
